assets.name: hero
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished website illustration asset for Pinata, a tool for pinning feedback to screenshots and sharing one link. The reference is the EXISTING BRAND LOGO: preserve its recognizable black donkey head, two tall rounded ears, white muzzle with single black dot, and orange pointed map-pin bottom. Do not redraw as a full-bodied animal. Extend that exact character into a playful paper-cut editorial illustration. Flat near-black #0D0D0D and vivid orange #FE512D, ivory and pale peach secondary shapes, subtly imperfect curves, almost no texture, crisp clean edges. Sophisticated minimal independent-software brand. Genuine transparent background, generous clear perimeter. No text, no lettering, no words, no watermark, no enclosing app-icon tile.
Asset: wide landscape homepage hero matching the style of reference image 2 (the capture process illustration). Build a fresh composition: an ivory browser card with bold near-black abstract page blocks sits left-of-center, three small orange location pins on it. The logo character peers over the card's upper-right corner, completely within frame. One orange curved line joins one pin to an ivory comment bubble on the right. Three sparse confetti pieces. Use the bold solid black blocks and simple flat forms of reference 2. Every shape is a solid flat paper cutout with ZERO shadows, ZERO glow, ZERO bloom, ZERO blurred halos, ZERO gradients. Clean isolated silhouettes, no surrounding backdrop. Reference image 1 provides character identity, reference image 2 provides art style. Entire artwork including ears fits with generous transparent padding.
